affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 992 on May 13, 1943; the official code table identifies students but names no institution.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms identity. Student status is not employment, and the school and Army-to-OSS chronology remain unknown.

affiliations.date_precision: The Federal Judicial Center dates Army service to 1942-1945; the Inquirer reports that Brotman left Yale to enlist and was then assigned to OSS.

affiliations.date_precision: The Inquirer states that Brotman left Yale in 1942 to enlist; the Federal Judicial Center records his later Yale B.A. in 1947.
